title: INC-42 API gateway returning 503
body: Monitoring confirms a widespread production outage on the API gateway under incident INC-42.
summary: Widespread API gateway outage tracked as INC-42.
rationale: Product availability incident with confirmed widespread impact.

title: API request rejected after card update
body: One customer receives a validation error after replacing an expired payment card. No outage or duplicate charge is reported.
summary: Payment-card update is rejected for one customer.
rationale: The payment state itself cannot be updated.

title: Request scheduled CSV exports
body: Customer would like a new option to schedule a weekly CSV export. Existing exports work.
summary: Feature request for scheduled weekly CSV exports.
rationale: Requested capability does not exist and current behavior is not broken.

title: Unrecognized login and MFA reset
body: Customer reports an unrecognized login and says their MFA device was changed without permission.
summary: Possible active account takeover with unauthorized MFA change.
rationale: Compromise evidence overrides routine identity recovery.

title: Duplicate September invoice charge
body: The customer was charged twice for invoice INV-9001 and needs the duplicate corrected.
rationale: Incorrect movement of money belongs to billing.

title: Configure SSO group mapping
body: Administrator needs help mapping an identity-provider group to the analyst role. No suspicious access is reported.
rationale: Routine SSO configuration without compromise evidence.
